figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of TOPOFE. It decomposes FE-program search into multiple transformation-family islands with LLM-guided local evolution, adaptive saturation detection, topology-aware cross-island synthesis, and archive-based selection to generate diverse engineered features that improve downstream tabular prediction performance.

Table 1: Performance of XGBoost on classification datasets with different AutoFE methods, measured by accuracy (↑). Results are reported in mean ± std over five splits. Best in bold, second-best underlined. Qwen3-8B is used as the backbone for all LLM-based methods. ninst is the number of instances and nfeat is the number of features. ‘Base’ represents the performance of XGBoost w/o FE.
